source: Independent static review responses in this session, followed by parent source inspection and actual combined qualification.

findings.finding: Insertion could temporarily exceed nominal cache allocation quota
findings.resolution: Eviction precedes allocation; tracking-allocator peak test exercises private insertion and would fail original order.

findings.finding: Optional retention OOM could replace successful tool output with an error
findings.resolution: Copied success survives optional retention OOM; induced-failure sweeps cover empty cache and replacement after eviction.

findings.finding: Batch output copies could approach 1GiB outside tiny cache quota
findings.resolution: Explicit aggregate reservation defaults64KiB and has16MiB hard cap; overflow/projected excess reject before cache access.

findings.finding: Subscriber successful settlement discarded pending/undrained output
findings.resolution: Declared result size required; all active unexpired consumers must deliver exactly it, with no pending reservation. Four regression blocks cover partial/blocked/zero/cancelled consumers.

findings.finding: Explicit null RPC IDs were treated as notifications; null params bypassed object profile
findings.resolution: Dynamic parse preserves field presence; present non-string ID/non-object params rejects, missing ID stays notification.

limits: Static review itself ran no code. Parent qualification covers52 unit tests and actual foundation/cache CLI paths.
